events.summary: During the Mirage Wars Ki'pamu stands as a stronghold of Zhalfirin resistance against Kaervek and withstands attacks by Jolrael's dragons.
events.quote: Ki’pamu was a stronghold for Zhalfirin resistance against Kaervek

events.summary: Asmira, Rashida Scalebane, Sidar Jabari and Hakim Loreweaver meet in Ki'pamu to start the rescue of Mangara.
Teferi phases Ki'pamu out with north-western Jamuraa to spare it the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Ki'pamu had been phased out alongside the rest of north-western Jamuraa

events.summary: Jeska destroys the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void, losing Ki'pamu forever from Dominaria.
events.quote: It was forever lost from Dominaria when Jeska destroyed the time rift over the Zhalfirin Void.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Wrenn and Realmbreaker return Zhalfir by swapping it with New Phyrexia; Ki'pamu now lies under Mirrodin's skies.
events.quote: Wrenn and Realmbreaker returned the phased-out Zhalfir to the multiverse
